Ernest Shackleton, South!.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ernest-shackleton/south

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ernest Shackleton, the author, died 1922 (Wikidata Q957543, P570 = 1922-01-05).

First publication of the text used: 1919 (SE colophon: 'South! was published in 1919 by Ernest Shackleton.'). Wikipedia: published in London by William Heinemann in 1919; the article names no US edition.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition states the text is in the United States public domain (statement quoted below).
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright lasts life plus 70 years after the death of the last person named above. The last to die did so in 1922, so the text entered the public domain there on 1 January 1993.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published 1919 by Ernest Shackleton.
- Wikipedia, South (book): published in London by William Heinemann in 1919; infobox country United Kingdom. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_(book)
